title: Light Ice Cream Cone, Chocolate, Prepackaged

content.title: About
content.content: Light ice cream cone is a ready‑to‑eat dessert consisting of a crisp waffle cone filled with a thin layer of chocolate ice cream. The product is packaged in individual portions, providing convenience for storage and transport.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The waffle cone is made from whole‑grain flour, making it lighter than traditional sweet cones.
The chocolate ice cream contains natural cocoa butter, giving it a characteristic aroma and creamy texture.
The packaging is made from biodegradable material suitable for composting.
Each portion is designed for a single serving – about 80 g of product.
The product contains no artificial colors or flavors.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Light ice cream contains less fat than traditional creamy versions, making it more suitable for diet‑conscious eating.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The dairy base of the ice cream provides a significant amount of calcium essential for bone health.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa butter is rich in polyphenols, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Carbohydrates from the milk and waffle cone quickly supply the body with energy.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Thanks to its fine crystalline structure, the ice cream melts quickly in the mouth and is easy to digest.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The product contains milk, which may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to lactose or casein.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Despite the light formula, added sugar is present, which should be considered by people with diabetes.

items.title: Temperature sensitivity
items.content: Storing above +4 °C can cause the ice cream to melt, altering its texture and flavor.

items.title: Choking hazard for children
items.content: Small chocolate particles may pose a choking risk for children under 3 years old.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product is ready to eat straight from the package. Optionally, garnish with berries, nuts, or a dusting of cocoa powder. Hold the cone by the base to avoid breakage.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a freezer at –18 °C or lower. After opening, consume within 24 hours. Do not keep at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
